mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 91 degrees and partly cloudy at Verona Area High School, with an air quality index of 58. We are seeing a waxing gibbous moon tonight with no visible space station passes, and we can look forward to an overnight low of 74 with rain in the forecast.

The student I Voted sticker design contest has closed for entries, and the city is excited to open community voting from July 28 through August 7. Also, remember to check your mailbox status before winter to ensure it meets public works specifications for snow plow season.

We have plenty to look forward to, with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, plus yoga tomorrow, followed by a full schedule of trivia nights and the downtown farmers market starting Tuesday.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a situation where a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after their vehicle became stuck on a large rock.
Indulge in today's flavor, OREO Cookie Overload, at our local Culver's, which is open until 10 PM tonight. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be Snickers Swirl.
